subject: Helios-4B variant: telemetry gating, integration blockers, and pin recommendation
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Jason Li <jason@helioslabs.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helios-4B variant onboarding: request for compat checks and pin recommendation

Team —

Helios Labs has reached out with a model they'd like us to host: Helios-4B (main variant + a 2B distilled variant). Product is seeing strong potential for search-ranking re-rank and short-form assistant completions; legal has verified the license but wants us to track usage.

Ask: can infra + runtime run a compatibility sweep and recommend a pin policy for the initial rollout? Specifically we need:
- a short compatibility note (KV cache, rotary/rope embedding behavior, max-seq quirks)
- quantization safety profile (float16 / q4_0 / q8_0)
- a suggested pin string we can use during canary (we expect to pin a version to avoid automatic roll-forward)
- recommended telemetry gating signals and thresholds we should use for automatic rollback (e.g., error rates, perplexity regressions, latency p95)

I've attached Helios-4B-specs.pdf and the model card they provided. Jason — appreciate if you can upload the checkpoint and a small test artifact (few inputs) to the S3 link so we can bootstrap tests.

Timeline: product would like a recommendation and a short runbook for a 5% canary by end of next week (target start ~2027-06-02). If you need more time, flag it here.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sr. PM, Model Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Helios-4B variant onboarding: request for compat checks and pin recommendation

On Tue, May 25, 2027 at 09:12 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Helios Labs has reached out with a model they'd like us to host: Helios-4B...

Thanks — quick read-through below and a proposed next step. High level: Helios-4B looks promising but we have three immediate compatibility concerns that block a safe pin recommendation today.

Blockers / things to validate:
1) KV cache layout: Helios uses a custom key ordering when doing multi-query attention for the 4B. We need a small regression test to validate our kv cache mapping vs. checkpoint behavior — if we get mismatch, token continuity will break for chat workloads.
2) Rotary/positioning: the model card indicates a hybrid rotary + absolute clamp. We need to confirm our rotary kernel supports the clamp region without numerical drift at long seq lengths (>2048).
3) Quantization paths: Helios's checkpoint has not been validated under our q4_0/q8_0 flows; we need quality delta numbers (ROUGE/accuracy on a held prompt set) before recommending q4 for production.

Suggested immediate work:
- Jason: please upload the full checkpoint + a 1k token sample prompt set. If possible also provide a small distilled 2B variant for early perf tests.
- Dev: add INF-2147 to run the compatibility test harness (kv/rotary/quant) and attach a short compat-test-plan.xlsx (I drafted one).
- Ops: propose telemetry gating signals: latency_p95 increase >15% or error rate >1% or QA score drop >5% over baseline should auto-fail canary.

I attached a draft compat-test-plan.xlsx — it lists test vectors, expected outputs, and a simple acceptance rubric. Once we have the pass/fail matrix we can propose a pin string.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 14:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helios-4B variant onboarding: request for compat checks and pin recommendation

Thanks — quick technical notes and a proposed pin/canary config.

Technical notes: we will need a small runtime shim for the rotary clamp if the model's clamp boundary differs from our default implementation. Kernel selection should be fine on A100s; for T4/edge GPUs we should validate memory layout for the KV cache. The checkpoint archive link Grace requested will be enough to run the compat harness.

Pin proposal: to avoid accidental roll-forward I propose we pin to an immutable identifier for the canary: "helios-4b-202705-locked". Operationally this will be a model-version pin that prevents the routing layer from auto-upgrading to other helios variants while the canary is active. If compat tests are green we can promote to "helios-4b-202705-stable" after a controlled rollout.

Canary config (recommended):
- initial traffic: 5% production routing, duration 48h
- telemetry thresholds: latency_p95 +15% vs baseline, error_rate >1% absolute, qa_score_drop >5% => rollback
- health signals: token-generation timeouts, OOMs, and prompt-output divergence metrics (we already have hooks for divergence)

I'm creating INF-2147 with acceptance criteria and will attach a runbook for the dev-oncall. I can target the compatibility sweep by EOD 2027-05-28 if Jason uploads the artifacts today.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Software Engineer, Serving Runtime

Priyom / Grace / Dev —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I uploaded the full Helios-4B checkpoint plus a smaller 2B distilled artifact to the S3 location: https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/helios-labs/models/helios-4b/checkpoint.tar.gz. The model card and a short inference sample set are also in the same bucket (helios-model-card.md). License is Apache-2.0 compatible.

Note: the 4B uses a hybrid rotary clamp; we included a short note in the model card describing the clamp breakpoints. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the embedding details.

For timeline: we'd like to be in a Redwood canary by the first week of June. If you can start tests this week and pin candidate is returned, we can aim for canary start 2027-06-02.

—Jason Li
